Quantitative Aesthetics · Assignment 05 · The environment as a signal

Three
Gunds

One walk through the Gund Hall trays, cut into 1000 frames. Three of us each taught CLIP what a column, a table, order and disorder look like, then let six classifiers watch the same video.

Every stripe is one frame. Pink: the model reads it as ordered. Blue: disordered. Same 1000 frames, three readings. Press play, or click a stripe to move the playhead.

aSource video and categories

Two stories in one room

Look up in the trays and you see white steel trusses, regular and repetitive. Look down and you see hundreds of desks buried in models, drawings and coffee cups. We picked column / table and ordered / disordered on purpose: columns seem to belong with order, tables with mess. We wanted to see whether that link would sneak into our models.
